judgments.evidence: Investor Irrational Behaviour and Abnormal Stock Returns: determines effects of herding, loss aversion, mental accounting, overconfidence on stock returns.
Hybrid MODWT-ARMA model combining wavelet and ARMA to deal with nonstationary and long-range dependence time series; outperforms benchmarks.
Patterns attributed to investor irrationality and abnormal profits; momentum payoffs disappear after adjusting for macro-based predictability.
Examines macroeconomic determinants of economic growth in Nigeria; co-integration shows long-run relationships.
Identifies the relevant capital structure theory (trade-off or pecking order) explaining financing decisions of overconfident managers.
